items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve been there quite a few times with Zala, Dave Zala. He has a program there; have a very good program there.

ctx.x: What is your general travel schedule these days?

Well, not much if I can help it. I’ve got, let’s see, I think in February I’ve got to run down to Baltimore for some society down there. In March I’m doing three days at the University of New Hampshire. I’ve been there quite a few times with Zala, Dave Zala. He has a program there; have a very good program there. I’ve been there a number of times. I’m doing three days there in March and then in April I’m going down to North Texas State to do a tribute to David Newman, David “Fathead” Newman. I was just saying…
